views.variant_sightings_public:
SELECT s.id AS sighting_id,
    s.variant_id,
    s.location_id,
    l.name AS location_name,
    l.area AS location_area,
    l.granularity AS location_granularity,
    p.name AS park_name,
    r.code AS resort_code,
    r.name AS resort_name,
    s.seen_at,
    s.availability,
    s.price_cents,
    s.currency,
    s.note,
    s.confirmation_count
   FROM sightings s
     JOIN locations l ON l.id = s.location_id
     JOIN parks p ON p.id = l.park_id
     JOIN resorts r ON r.id = p.resort_id
  WHERE NOT s.hidden AND NOT s.is_demo AND s.flag_count < 3 AND s.seen_at > (now() - '90 days'::interval);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_shopping_signup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE channel text:=CASE WHEN new.raw_user_meta_data->>'shopping_signup_source'='mobile' THEN 'mobile' ELSE 'web' END;
 opted boolean:=coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'shopping_alerts'='true',false);
BEGIN
 IF new.raw_user_meta_data->>'shopping_terms_version'='2026-11-12' THEN
  INSERT INTO public.shopping_accounts(user_id,terms_version,terms_accepted_at,shopping_alerts,alerts_version,alerts_updated_at,
   mobile_terms_version,mobile_terms_accepted_at,mobile_shopping_alerts,mobile_alerts_updated_at)
  VALUES(new.id,'2026-11-12',now(),opted,'2026-11-12',now(),
   CASE WHEN channel='mobile' THEN '2026-11-12' END,CASE WHEN channel='mobile' THEN now() END,
   channel='mobile' AND opted,CASE WHEN channel='mobile' THEN now() END);
  INSERT INTO public.shopping_consents(user_id,subject,purpose,allowed,version,source) VALUES
   (new.id,'u:'||new.id::text,'terms',true,'2026-11-12',channel),
   (new.id,'u:'||new.id::text,'shopping_alerts',opted,'2026-11-12',channel);
 END IF;
 RETURN new;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_shopping_privacy(subject_key text, member_id uuid, personalize boolean, advertise boolean, policy text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
 insert into shopping_privacy(subject,personalization,advertising) values(subject_key,personalize,advertise)
 on conflict(subject) do update set personalization=excluded.personalization,advertising=excluded.advertising,updated_at=now();
 insert into shopping_consents(subject,user_id,purpose,allowed,version) values
 (subject_key,member_id,'personalization',personalize,policy),(subject_key,member_id,'advertising',advertise,policy);
 if not personalize then perform clear_shopping_history(subject_key); end if;
 if not advertise then update shopping_ad_outbox set status='suppressed' where subject=subject_key and status='pending'; end if;
end $function$
